name: Steroids
overview: Scripture teaches that true strength and renewal come not from external means but from trusting wholly in the Lord and acknowledging Him in all our ways. As Isaiah 40:31 promises, those who wait on the Lord will have their strength renewed and will endure without weariness. This divine strength brings comfort and peace even in the darkest trials, as Psalm 23:4 and John 14:27 affirm, reminding believers that God’s presence and peace sustain them beyond worldly measures. Ultimately, the greatest gift of life and strength is found in the saving grace of Christ, as declared in John 3:16.
